book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Lilalukilu panani ja lujiniku lwaka Yesu
Lichobha limu Yesu akabhi pa Nyumba jaka Chapanga, akabhatangazya bhandu Malobhi Manyahi. Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa na bhabhola bha Shelia papamu na bhakolongwa bha bhandu bhakunhikile,
na kundalukila, “Utupwaghilaje! Bho, uhenga mambu ghanihagha kwa lujiniku lwaka nane? Na bho, nane joakupeki lujiniku loniholo?”
Yesu akabhayangiki, “Na nenga ananundalukya lilaluki limu. Mbwaghilaje,
bho, ubatizu waka Yohana ukahumiki kwaka Chapanga au kwa bhandu?”
Nambu bhombi bhakapwaghani ana, “Anatupwaghiki ukahumiki kwaka Chapanga, anaatulalukya, ‘Bho, mbona ngachemunhobhalile Yohana?’
Nambu anatupwaghiki, ‘Ukahumiki kwa bhandu,’ bhandu bhokapi anabhutulapula maganga, maghambu bhokapi bhahobhalela kubha Yohana akabhi nde mlota waka Chapanga.”
Bhela bhakumpwaghile, “Ngachetumanyi ukahumiki kwako.”
Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Hata nenga nganumpwaghi kubha ndenda mambu ghangane kwa lujiniku lwaka nane.”
Ulenganesu wa ngonda wa mizabibu na bhalemi bhahakau

Yesu akajendali kubhapwaghi bhandu ulenganesu agho, “Mundu jumu akapandiki ngonda wa mizabibu. Akabhajahiki bhalemi ngonda ghola, na kutumbu mwanja wa kujenda ku inchi jengi na kutama konihoku kwa chikahi chilachu.
Chikahi cha mahunu pachahikili, akuntumiki mtumwa waki kwa bhalemi bhala, nahuli akatola pandu pa mahunu gha mizabibu. Nambu bhalemi bhakundapwi mtumwa jola na kunkelebhu mabhoku matopu.
Mweni ngonda jola akuntumiki mtumwa jongi, nambu jonihoju najombi bhelabhela bhakundapwili na kuntende mambu gha iyoni, na kunkelabhu mabhoku matopu.
Akumtumiki kabheti mtumika wa katatu, jonihoju najombi, bhakumpotiki na kuntopola.
Bhela mweni ngonda jola akapwaghike, ‘Bho, anandenda bhole? Ananuntuma mwana wangu jonumpalike, pangi anabhuntopilaje jombi.’
Nambu bhalemi bhala pabhumbweni akahikaje, bhakapwaghanile, ‘Ajoju nde mpwelelu wa ngonda. Bhela tunkomaje nahuli upwelelu waki ubya witu.’
Bhela bhakunkamwili na kumpiha kunja ja ngonda wa mizabibu na kunkoma.” Yesu akalalukile, “Bho, mweni ngonda anaabhatenda kyani bhalemi bhanihabha?

Anahika na kubhakoma bhalemi habha, na kubhapeke bhalemi bhangi ngonda wa mizabibu hoghu.” Bhandu pabhajowini ulenganesu hoghu, bhakapwaghike, “Ngabhela! Chapanga ajepisha kutali mambu ghanihagha ngaghipitalila.”
Nambu Yesu akabhalingalakili na kubhalalukila, “Bho, Malembu hagha ndandi jaki kike?

content.text: sajenu libhi lighanga likolongwa lelipalika nakanopi.’

content: Mundu jokapi joanahabhuka panani ja lighanga heli, anatunyukana ipandi ipandi, na mundu jolanhwabhukya lighanga heli, analunhyagha nakanope.”
Kulepa kode kwaka Kaisali
Bhabhola bha Shelia na bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa bhakapaliki kunkamu Yesu palapala, maghambu bhakamanyi kubha ulenganesu hoghu walongale bhombe, nambu bhabhajoghupa bhandu.
Bhela bhakatumbwi kunjobhale Yesu, bhakabhatumiki bhandu bhakopunganya kubha bhamboni nahuli bhunkamula Yesu kwa malobhi ghaki, nahuli bhumpeleka kwaka nkolongwa wa inchi ja ku Loma.

Bhandu bhala bhakundaluki Yesu, “Mbola, tumanyi kubha ulongela na kubhola malobhi gha chakaka. Bhelabhela wehapa ngacheulingali lujiniku lwaka mundu, nambu ubhola indela ja chakaka ngati Chapanga moapali bhandu tutamaje.
Tupwaghilaje, bho, wichu le kwitu tepani kulepa kode kwaka Kaisali au ngatwilepa?”
Nambu Yesu akaumanyi uhakau wabhu, akabhapwaghile,
“Mnangiya lingengelema la mbija. Bho, jibhi na sula na lihina laka nane?” Na bhombi bhakayangiki, “Jaka Kaisali.”
Bhela Yesu akabhapwaghile, “Bhela mumpekya Kaisali, yeibhi yaki Kaisali, na mumpekya Chapanga yeibhi yaki Chapanga.”
Bhela bhandu bhala ngachebhaweziki kunkamula kwa chela cheakalongi palongi ja bhandu, nambu bhakakangichi na liyangu laki, na bhombi bhakatumbile.
Lilalukilu panani ja kuyoka
Masadukayo bhakumu, bhabhapwagha kubha bhakuwa ngabhiyoki, bhakunjendi Yesu na kundalukila,

“Mbola, Musa akatulaghalaki ana, ‘Ngati ndongu waka mundu anapotili na kundeka nhwanu waki panga mwana, ndongu waki apalika antoghula mbomba joaweliwi na ndomi jola nahuli ambelakya bhana ndongu waki joapoti jola.’
Bhela kukabhi na bhalongu saba, wa kutumbula akatowili na kupotela panga kupata bhana.
Ndongu wa kabhele akuntowi joaweliwi na ndomi jola, najombi akapotoli panga kupata bhana,
na ndongu wa katatu najombi kukabhi bhelabhela. Mambu ghakabhi ghalaghala kwa bhokapi saba na bhokapi bhakapotili panga kubhaleka bhana.
Pakujomukela jaki mbomba jola akapotile.
Henu palichobha bhakuwa pabhiyokaje, mbomba jonihoju anabya nhwanu waka nane? Maghambu bhokapi saba bhakabhi bhuntowile.”
Yesu akabhayangike, “Bhandu bha pundema pani bhatoghola na kutoghuleka.
Nambu kwa bhala ambabhu Chapanga abhabhona kubha bhapalika kuyoka na kubha bhomi pa ndema ghouhika, ngabhitogholi wala kutoghuleka.
Kutumbu panihapa ngabhikuwi kabhete. Maghambu bhibya ngati bhatumika bha kunani kumahunde bhaka Chapanga. Na bhombi nde bhana bhaka Chapanga, maghambu bhatehi kuyohakeka.

Nambu kupwagha kubha bhakuwa bhiyokaje, hata Musa akalangi hotuhotu mu Malembu Mahuhu panani ja lijambu leniheli, kubhokana na kihole chekibhelala motu. Jombi andongale Bambo kubha ngati nde, ‘Chapanga waka Ibulahimu, Chapanga waka Isaka na Chapanga waka Yakobo.’
Jombi nga Chapanga wa bhabhawile, nambu jombi nde Chapanga wa bhabhabhi bhome, maghambu kwaki jombi bhokapi bhakubha bhome.”
Bhabhola bhakumu bha Shelia bhakapwaghike, “Mbola, uyangiki wichu!”
Nga mundu joakalengiki kabheti kundaluki malobhi ghange.
Kristo Mwana waka nane?
Yesu akajendali kubhapwaghila, “Bho, kubhi bholi bhandu bhapwagha kubha Kristo nde Mwana waka Daude?
Daude mweni akapwaghiki mu chitabu cha Zabuli,

content.text: mbaka panabhabheka maadui bhaku pahi ja magholu ghaku.’

content: Ngati Daude akandohiki Kristo ‘Bambo,’ henu ayibya bho mwana wake?”
Yesu abhalakalila bhabhola bha Shelia
Bhandu bhokapi pabhakabhi bhunjowanela, Yesu akabhapwaghi bhabhulwa bhaki,

“Mulijepa na bhabhola bha Shelia bhabhapala kujenda koni bhakabya bhawati ingobhu ilachu na kupala kulamukiwa na bhandu kwa kutopela paligulio, bhelabhela bhapala kutama kwitehu ya kutopela mu nyumba ja kuhimangani Bhayahude na pandu pakutopela pa uwangalalu wa chilebhe.
Bhakula mu nyumba ya bhabhaweliwi na bhalomi bhabhu, na kwa undumila kubheli bhalobha malobhu malachu. Bhanganya bhanihabha bhitemuliwa nakanopi!”
